integrity: Exact symbolic invariance equations plus analytic center-manifold and Lyapunov proof; finite numerical tests are diagnostics, not proof. Literature novelty limited to inspected materials.
scientific_limitations: Fixed n>0 and normalized physical time; no uniform n->0 law, no global classification for m>0, no explicit strong-stable manifold equation or orbit-dependent integration constant.
title: Global critical attraction and an exact logarithmic clock in the T-system
